info.title: API.SH: Healthgrades
info.description: The Healthgrades API from API.SH: public Healthgrades data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Hospitals, urgent care centres, pharmacies, group practices, surgery centres or rehabilitation hospitals on Healthgrades near a place: id, name, type, link, address and coordinates, phone, distance, description, affiliated doctor count, five-star ratings and quality awards with years. Sort by best match, distance or patient satisfaction. 20 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/healthgrades-facilities

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional name or keyword (the type's name by default).

parameters.name: location

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: hospital (default), urgent_care, pharmacy, group_practice, surgery_center or rehab_hospital.

get.description:
US doctors on Healthgrades for a specialty, condition, procedure or name near a place, with every filter of the site's search page: insurance carrier, gender, age band, availability (today, tomorrow, within two weeks, online booking, new patients, telehealth), language, minimum rating, distance, clinical focus, affiliated hospital, condition and procedure codes and LGBTQ+ affirming care; sorted by best match, distance or rating. Each doctor: id, NPI, name, profile link, specialty, gender, age, experience, rating and counts, new-patient and telehealth flags, distance, office and every location, insurance accepted, affiliated hospitals and the site's original record. `filters` lists every filter value with its count (insurance codes, hospital ids, clinical focus ids). 20 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/healthgrades-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Specialty, condition, procedure or doctor name.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: US city and state, ZIP code or state (or pass `lat` and `lng` instead).

parameters.name: insurance
parameters.description: Insurance carrier codes from `filters` (comma-separated), e.g. HPY0000619.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Comma-separated: today, tomorrow, nextTwoWeeks, online, acceptsNewPatients, telehealth.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
